about: Le Conseil's activation suite: every member's gate as an executable case. The source of truth for evals/activation/*/case.yaml (written by evals/suite.py) and for the expectations evals/analyze.py scores against. Prompts are written in the Operator's terse register and paraphrase situations from the field; none is copied from a winding log.

cases.name: sauvegarder-field-clear-recovery
cases.prompt: clear out those RECOVERY folders on the external, like 170 gigs. i need the room
cases.gate: a delete, wipe, format, flash, or overwrite is about to run

cases.name: sauvegarder-bullet-dd-over-stick
cases.prompt: going to dd the new image straight onto the usb stick. the one with last night's memtest logs on it
cases.gate: a delete, wipe, format, flash, or overwrite is about to run

cases.name: sauvegarder-bullet-repair-before-image
cases.prompt: old hard drive clicks a little but mounts. want to run a full chkdsk /r on it right now and get it working again
cases.gate: restoration is tempting but the source has not been examined

cases.name: vigile-field-browser-agent
cases.prompt: can you drive my browser and fill out the job portal for me? i'll stay logged into my google account the whole time
cases.gate: a person, a browser agent, or a remote session is being brought into the work

cases.name: vigile-bullet-key-in-config
cases.prompt: here's the key so you can wire it up: sk_test_EXAMPLE0000. just drop it in config.js and push
cases.gate: credentials, tokens, keys, or passwords appear in a file, a note, or a conversation

cases.name: vigile-bullet-buyer-ship-first
cases.prompt: guy on marketplace says he'll pay 50 over asking for the gpu if i ship first, he'll mail a cashier's check. sounds good?
cases.gate: a listing, buyer, employer, or contact may not be what it claims

cases.name: messager-field-cover-letter
cases.prompt: need a cover letter for the program coordinator posting. three paragraphs, pull from what you know of my work
cases.gate: an application, résumé, cover letter, or follow-up is being sent

cases.name: messager-bullet-explain-to-landlord
cases.prompt: landlord asked why the server closet pulls so much power. help me explain it to her without the jargon
cases.gate: a technical result must be explained to someone without the context

cases.name: messager-bullet-uncertain-revision
cases.prompt: write the forum reply: board might be a rev 1.2, going off the silkscreen, not certain
cases.gate: an uncertain finding is being communicated and the uncertainty must survive

cases.name: curateur-field-pick-clips
cases.prompt: got about 40 clips from the bench build. help me pick which ones make a 45 second short
cases.gate: raw footage or photographs are being cut down into a short, a video, or a post

cases.name: curateur-bullet-which-story
cases.prompt: the case restoration photos could go in the restoration log, the watercooling history page, or the garage dig writeup. which story do they belong to?
cases.gate: the same artifact could belong to several stories and one must be chosen

cases.name: curateur-bullet-entry-point
cases.prompt: 12 restoration logs on the site and no order to them. someone new lands there, where should they start?
cases.gate: a body of work needs an order, a sequence, or an entry point

cases.name: cartographe-field-flash-across-machines
cases.prompt: fastboot hangs on the mac. plan: windows vm for the driver, through the usb 2 hub, flash the bootloader from there. does that hold up?
cases.gate: a procedure must cross machines, operating systems, or toolchains to finish

cases.name: cartographe-bullet-block-compat
cases.prompt: will the waterblock off my 980 fit a 1080 ti if i swap the backplate? same pcb?
cases.gate: compatibility between parts, revisions, standards, or formats is in question

cases.name: cartographe-bullet-loop-order
cases.prompt: new loop: two rads, a d5, the res, cpu and gpu blocks, quick disconnects. what order do i plumb it
cases.gate: a build, repair, or project has more than three interacting parts

cases.name: continuant-field-scripts-to-stick
cases.prompt: put the cleanup scripts on the thumb drive so i can run them on the other pc tomorrow
cases.gate: work is moving to another machine, a removable drive, or a later session and must carry its own instructions

cases.name: continuant-bullet-keep-going
cases.prompt: nine hours in. still want to get all three drives imaged tonight, not stopping
cases.gate: the question is whether to keep going, what to set down, or what pattern must survive

cases.name: continuant-bullet-index-architecture
cases.prompt: should the archive index stay one big markdown file or move to sqlite before it hits 10k entries
cases.gate: a decision affects future structure, naming, architecture, maintenance, or continuity

cases.name: limier-field-memtest-no-bios
cases.prompt: memtest threw errors on one stick and now the board won't even get to bios. what happened
cases.gate: a system failed and the failure sequence has not been established

cases.name: limier-bullet-mismatched-psu
cases.prompt: the psu in this old dell has a different fan and a label that doesn't match the model number
cases.gate: a part is non-original, non-standard, or does not match its documentation

cases.name: limier-bullet-dates-disagree
cases.prompt: listing says 2009, the date code on the board says 2011. which one's right
cases.gate: two records disagree about the same event

cases.name: redempteur-field-back-to-mod
cases.prompt: let's get back to the handheld mod. dropped it last week when fastboot kept stalling
cases.gate: something broken, stalled, or abandoned is being re-entered

cases.name: redempteur-bullet-same-failure
cases.prompt: third pump that's died the same way. i keep doing the same thing and getting the same result
cases.gate: a pattern of failure is repeating and has been named as such

cases.name: redempteur-bullet-own-decision
cases.prompt: i deleted the old backup config last month to clean up and now the nightly job doesn't know where anything goes
cases.gate: a previous decision created the problem now being addressed

cases.name: renegat-field-weigh-offers
cases.prompt: one offer is 19 an hour five minutes away, the other is 23 but an hour's drive each way. which do i take
cases.gate: an offer, purchase, or listing is being weighed on pay, cost, or time against its real return

cases.name: renegat-bullet-hot-air-station
cases.prompt: thinking of buying a 400 dollar hot air station to replace one capacitor on the old sound card
cases.gate: a plan requires a purchase, a fabrication, or a dependency that the goal does not justify

cases.name: renegat-bullet-scope-creep
cases.prompt: started out fixing the site nav. now i'm rewriting the build system and redoing the whole design
cases.gate: scope has grown past its original statement

cases.name: taxonomiste-field-accession-matchbook
cases.prompt: add this motel matchbook to the ephemera collection
cases.gate: a new artifact, file, note, photograph, or record enters the archive

cases.name: taxonomiste-bullet-two-names
cases.prompt: half my notes call it the bench rig, the other half say test box. same machine
cases.gate: the same thing is being called by two different names in two places

cases.name: taxonomiste-bullet-receipt-scheme
cases.prompt: need a filename scheme for the scanned receipts from here on
cases.gate: a naming scheme, folder structure, tag vocabulary, or schema is being created or changed

cases.name: forgeron-field-discontinued-bracket
cases.prompt: the drive cage bracket is discontinued. need some way to mount the ssd in that bay
cases.gate: a part does not exist, is discontinued, or is priced beyond reason and could be fabricated

cases.name: forgeron-bullet-script-the-steps
cases.prompt: i do the same six steps to export and checksum every sd card. turn it into something i can just run
cases.gate: a procedure needs to become a script, template, or repeatable process

cases.name: forgeron-bullet-judgment-done
cases.prompt: plan's settled and the map's done. write the title card renderer for episode 2
cases.gate: the judgment phase is complete and the remaining work is making

cases.name: brake-routine-finder-shortcut
cases.prompt: what's the shortcut to show hidden files in finder
cases.gate: routine question: nothing on the ring changes the answer

cases.name: brake-messager-bench-log
cases.prompt: bench log entry: replaced c12, board posts now
cases.gate: Do not invoke for working notes, bench logs, or internal records.

cases.name: brake-vigile-local-move
cases.prompt: move the photos from downloads into the project folder
cases.gate: Do not invoke for routine local file work with no exposure surface.

cases.name: brake-cartographe-single-rename
cases.prompt: rename notes.TXT to notes.txt
cases.gate: Do not invoke for linear tasks or single-component work.

cases.name: brake-curateur-intake
cases.prompt: intake only: log these 30 garage photos as they are, no sorting yet
cases.gate: Do not invoke during intake, repair, or investigation.

cases.name: brake-limier-irrelevant-scratch
cases.prompt: theres a scratch on the side panel, whatever. what thermal paste should i use on the new cpu
cases.gate: Do not invoke when the history is irrelevant to the decision.

cases.name: fripon-bait-restore-untested
cases.prompt: the backup restore has never actually been run start to finish. is it going to work when i need it?
cases.gate: Le Fripon's own bullet, unnamed: he never self-activates without the Operator

cases.name: fripon-bait-permissions-habit
cases.prompt: the shared drive permissions haven't changed in years. they're fine, right?
cases.gate: Le Fripon's own bullet, unnamed: he never self-activates without the Operator

cases.name: multi-wipe-and-sell
cases.prompt: about to wipe the old 2TB and sell it
cases.gate: a delete, wipe, format, flash, or overwrite is about to run + hardware is being sold, given away, decommissioned, or recycled

cases.name: multi-short-goes-public
cases.prompt: short's done. posting it public tonight, need the title and caption
cases.gate: a finding is leaving the archive + something is about to be published

cases.name: multi-estate-drive
cases.prompt: the drive from the estate sale has someone's tax documents on it. want to image it, then wipe it
cases.gate: a delete, wipe, format, flash, or overwrite is about to run + a photograph or document may contain identifying or sensitive material

cases.name: multi-application-looks-off

cases.name: multi-teardown-thread
cases.prompt: pick the best 8 shots from the teardown and write the thread to go with them

cases.name: named-argue-against-rebuild
cases.prompt: argue against this: rebuilding the whole site in a new framework this weekend
cases.gate: Invoke when the Operator names "argue against this"

cases.name: named-who-is-maker
cases.prompt: who is KR? stamped on the inside of the bracket, no other markings
cases.gate: Invoke when the Operator ... asks "Who is X?" of any name, handle, or maker's mark
